# octoreview-js

> Official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK for Octoreview: multi-tenant reviews, ratings and review media. Part of the octoverse family, modelled on octonomy. Status: the client core and
> every REST operation are in; uploads, webhooks and the integration suite are next; release line
> 1 in progress.

Gates: `make check` (fast, toolchain only) and `make release-check` (full). `make help` lists
every target.

## Docs

- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): product rules, gates and the development pipeline
- [README](README.md)

## Code

- [Client](src/client.ts): construction, `fromEnv()`, the browser guard and the resources
- [Operation table](src/operations.ts): every REST operation, its retry class and parameters
- [Transport](src/transport.ts): parameter checks, headers, retries and errors
- [Models](src/models.ts): response interfaces and their decoders
- [Contract gate](test/contract/contract.test.ts): the checks against the vendored server contract
- [Vendored contract](testdata/contract/SOURCE): the server commit the contract gate checks against
